Basic chat completion via the GitHub Copilot provider (gpt-4o) with a single user message

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chat({ maxTokens: 16, messages: [{ content: "Say hello in one word.", role: "user" }], model: "github_copilot/gpt-4o", temperature: 0 });
  console.log(result.choices);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.message?.content);
  console.log(result.choices?.[0]?.finishReason);
  console.log(result.model);
  console.log(result.usage?.totalTokens);
}

void main();
```
